text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp had already reached its midpoint—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Shall we run, Tama?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri... Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm headin' out, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two dashed off side by side,
both running in mesmerizing form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooosh, whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, there's something
I wanna ask ya.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What're ya runnin' for anyway?
Is it 'cause you're from the countryside,
and wanna prove everyone wrong?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Prove them wrong... Prove them wrong, huh...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't think... that's quite right.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I just want to do my best for the people cheering me on
far away in my hometown.
For the ones who mean the world to me."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Someone precious... Right, well, if it's that sort of thing,
I've got someone like that too."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"If they're that precious... have ya never thought like this?
That ya'd rather stay by their side than win in the Tracen Central?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't think so. I have no intention of quitting racing and going back home.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: W-Why's that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Me winning in the Central League—that's everyone's dream.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is pinning their dreams on me.
They want me to win and become a star Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even if I go back, I can't fulfill it.
Everyone's dreams aren't there.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I run.
In the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Running is your... dream...
I see...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (Oguri... you and me really are alike after all. I run for my family, and you run for your hometown...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Still, you... had already moved way past
the things I was struggling with, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(My running is everyone's dream...
Understanding that...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, can I ask ya one more thing?
Watching your races always gets my heart pounding like crazy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What do you usually think about on the final straight?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"The final stretch... I'm not thinking about... anything...
In the end, I will..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Giving everything until you're empty.
And once empty, unable to run ever again...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But from there...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Their faces flash through my mind. Shige-san, Chiyo-san, Yoshi-san—the faces of everyone who sent me off.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
All the people who brought me treats,
and gave me so much support...
I just have to live up to everyone's cheers...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"When I think about that, once again my heart... my stomach...
even the tips of my toes begin to burn hot."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"From there, I begin to run again.
Strangely enough, my body moves. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I will not lose.
—As long as I have the strength everyone gave me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh—?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"So you ran outta steam during the race...
and managed to pull yerself back together from there...?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So that's why her races are so fun to watch...
No, more than that...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (Even when her strength is completely spent, this feeling of gratitude still wells up. That is what makes her...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see... ...Nah.
They might look similar, but they're totally different.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're—the exact opposite.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The exact opposite...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You've built up your strength by 'eating.'
Receiving plenty of meals and heart from everyone around you,
you're completely stuffed...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"On the flip side, I turned that 'hunger' into my strength.
Even if I couldn't eat properly, I swore I'd make it big someday!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We faced the same adversity, but the way we met it was different.
Whether by coincidence or by personality, who knows...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I see, Oguri, you were...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (You're... another me. Another version of me that could've been...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Even though we were poor, everyone around me
supported me. In other words—)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(She's the exact image of the Umamusume
I always wanted to be as a kid.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's how it is...
No wonder I couldn't stop thinkin' about it...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're... you're the only one who's special.
There's no way I'd just turn tail and run out on ya.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta run against you—no doubt about it.
We gotta run and settle this once and for all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama...! Hearing you say that makes me...
so happy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Right now! I wanna run with her right now!
I can't help how badly I wanna win!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (Still... not quite yet. Gotta hold out just a bit longer.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Even so, Oguri. You still have the Classic road ahead of you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
First off, give it your all in the Kikuka Sho!
I know you've got this...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Huh? What's up, Oguri?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I will—not go to the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Say what? Ah, right. Shorter
distances are more your thing, after all."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's true, but that's not quite what I mean.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: At the Kikuka Sho... At the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Because Tamamo Cross isn't in it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the summer a year ago... no, maybe even before then.
I've been thinking about it all along.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Just how much fighting spirit does Tama possess? Just how strong will she become?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I respect this Umamusume with all my heart.
I never met someone quite like her
back in my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want to run with Tama no matter what.
I want to compete with her as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's why I won't go to the Kikuka Sho.
The race I'll run is the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
And then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The one I want to beat is Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri... Y-You...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You really are something else...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was that... a bother?
Sorry, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Damn right you are! To think that you...
that you'd come barging into the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's what I wanted!! It's the absolute best!!
Well said!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: If that's how you wanna play it, then I've had it up to here!! I can't hold back anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're my archrival! A junior chasing after me,
a goal I'm chasing after—basically everything!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! You better bring everything you've got this autumn and winter!!
We're makin' it our stage!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Classic, Senior—none of that matters!
Hit me with everything you've got!!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll take on everything you've got
and blow it right back at ya!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Let's do that, Tama.
I'm so glad. I'm really glad I took the plunge and told you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The next day, I heard the whole story
from Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two grand dreams are about to collide.
Two brilliant, shining white dramas.
